newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks end flat in token volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks end flat in token volume.

text.p: Argentine stocks closed flat in a very dull market with token volume in light of the U.S. Thanksgiving market holiday.
"Holidays in the U.S. have a strong influence on the local market, with investors keeping to the sidelines due to the lack of foreign references," a dealer said.
"The few businesses done were basically local," said Gustavo Galfione, of Velox Inversiones.
Blue chip index MerVal closed flat at 603.58 points, while the broader general index shed 0.32 percent.
Volume fell steeply to a meager $4.6 million from Wednesday's $16.3 million. Losers beat gainers 14 to seven with 31 shares ending flat.
Best performers among main tiers were papermaker Celulosa with a 5.04 pecent rise and oil firm Sol Petroleo with 4.34.
"The market is awaiting the foreign gauge to resume business tomorrow," said Alfredo Alessandro of Alessandro y Cia.
Dealers expect scarce activity to continue Friday and a slight correction after the market rose more than five percent so far this month, but are upbeat for the medium term.
